instance.longDescription: Shows routes for specified RIB, VRF, and node(s).

network.description: Return routes for networks matching this prefix.

nodes.description: Return routes on nodes matching this specifier.

prefixMatchType.description: Use this prefix matching criterion: EXACT, LONGEST_PREFIX_MATCH, LONGER_PREFIXES, SHORTER_PREFIXES.

protocols.description: Return routes for protocols matching this specifier.

rib.description: Only return routes from a given protocol RIB.

vrfs.description: Return routes on VRFs matching this name or regex.
